input.summary: Broaden Customer's assignment carve-out in 22.4 to cover Affiliates and successors in any merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, mirroring M&I's own free-assignment right.
input.comment: [Playbook] We need the customary affiliate and successor carve-out for our own assignments: as drafted M&I may freely assign on a merger, reorganisation or asset sale while we may only do so on a merger to an acquirer with $100,000,000 of capital and surplus. This edit simply mirrors M&I's carve-out for us; we remain happy to keep the Section 21.11 conditions.

ops.oldText: (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement pursuant to a merger in which Customer is a party and as a result of which the surviving corporation becomes an Affiliate of another bank holding company, bank, savings and loan association or other financial institution having a capital and surplus of at least $100,000,000 so long as the provisions of Section 21.11 are complied with
ops.newText: (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement to an Affiliate of Customer or pursuant to a merger, acquisition, corporate reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assets, stock or securities of Customer, so long as the provisions of Section 21.11 are complied with
